text: I bought the Aurora X2 recently and i think they just exceeded what i was anticipating. The noise cancellation is the thing that amazes me. The battery gets you up to 30 hours on a charge. But the cushions hurt your ears if you listen too long. The app is kinda flakey, it can just stop working after a while.
